g.text: One key joins the request path to the bill
Every hop stamps the same generation ID and routing mode. That is the only thing the benchmark record needs.
REQUEST PATH — WHAT THE USER WAITS FOR
the join key — stamped by every hop above, carried by every record below
median · p90 · tok/s · speed versus cost, per routing mode
Grey dashes = the hop stamps the key. · Teal dashes = the record carries the key. · Solid teal = it becomes a comparable benchmark row.
The two views are never joined by wall-clock time, which is why identical tasks stay comparable across routing modes.
